title: Cangurul — learn algorithms with a kangaroo
description: A free program for students: write simple commands and the kangaroo hops across the field, drawing lines. For Windows, Linux and macOS.
hero_lead: Students write simple commands — STEP, JUMP, ROTATE — and the kangaroo hops across the field, drawing as it goes. That is how they learn what an algorithm, a loop and a procedure are.
hero_compat: .cng programs from Cangurul 2 open and run without any changes.
screenshot_alt: The Cangurul window: the program on the left, the field where the kangaroo wrote CANGUR on the right
f1_text: Commands are highlighted and lines are numbered. While you type, completions appear, indentation takes care of itself, and <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>F</kbd> tidies up the whole program.
f2_text: The program is checked on every edit, before it runs: misspelled words, unclosed blocks, missing procedures, loops that may never end. For a misspelled word, the Fix button puts in the right one.
f3_text: The kangaroo moves smoothly and the editor highlights the line being executed. Run it step by step, pause it, slow it down or finish instantly.
f1_alt: The editor: command buttons and the program with highlighted commands
f3_alt: The field where the kangaroo drew the letters CANGUR, with the Run and Step buttons
analyzer_alt: The analyzer points out a mistake in the program and suggests a fix
compare_lead: Everything students and teachers already know stays the same. Version 3 adds:
cmp_analyzer: Checking the program as you type, with fixes
cmp_line: The running line highlighted in the editor
dl_msi_note: choose the folder and a desktop shortcut; .cng files open with a double click
dl_mac_note: On first launch: right-click Cangurul.app → Open (on macOS 15+: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway).
lab_options: INSTALLFOLDER changes the folder, DESKTOPSHORTCUT="" skips the desktop shortcut.
